summary: @ornikar/jest-config-react-native-web preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall: 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (_0x... identifiers) and, on npm install, selects a platform-specific Bun archive URL under github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (bun-v1.3.13), downloads and extracts the Bun binary to a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and immediately runs the sibling file math_init.js with that freshly downloaded Bun binary via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-CJS bundle whose entire body is string-array rotation obfuscation (a WV8StW helper rotating a ~2000-entry mixed-constant pool n7gIxM), so its behavior is deliberately hidden from Node-based inspection. The advertised main entry jest-preset.js is a decoy that only throws 'Use @ornikar/jest-config-react-native/web instead' — the package has no functional jest preset content, and the scope resembles the legitimate @ornikar shared-configs namespace. Installing this package causes an alternate runtime to be fetched and used to execute a large obfuscated payload the installer has never seen, satisfying the alternate-runtime dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
